items.description: Luz muy apreciada que cruza el cielo nocturno como una estrella fugaz. Atrápala antes de que se extinga y tal vez podrás cambiarla por otra cosa.

items.name: Pase especial de los raíles estelares
items.description: Boleto directo del Expreso Astral. Registra las coordenadas de un mundo específico. Adecuado para los pasajeros que tengan un objetivo específico.

items.name: Pase de los raíles estelares
items.description: Boleto universal del Expreso Astral. Sigue los raíles estelares y viaja por los distintos mundos.

items.name: Cosmiluz inextinguible
items.description: Gemas relucientes que se formaron a partir de la solidificación de una estrella fugaz que cayó del cielo.

items.name: Ascuas inextinguibles
items.description: Cenizas de una estrella fugaz que cayó del cielo.

items.name: Eidolon (5)
items.description: Material para mejorar el nivel de Eidolon de un personaje de 5 estrellas.

items.name: Eidolon (4)
items.description: Material para mejorar el nivel de Eidolon de un personaje de 4 estrellas.

items.name: Sombra de la Destrucción
items.description: Material para mejorar el nivel de Eidolon del Trazacaminos (Destrucción).

items.name: Sombra de la Conservación
items.description: Material para mejorar el nivel de Eidolon del Trazacaminos (Conservación)

items.name: Crédito
items.description: Divisa que utiliza la Corporación para la Paz Interastral para sus cuentas con los clientes y que se acepta en todas partes como moneda de los viajes espaciales.

items.name: Hertareum
items.description: Criptomoneda que circula de forma interna en la Estación Espacial. Sirve para comprar artículos en tiendas específicas.

items.name: Escudo
items.description: La moneda oficial de Belobog. Sirve para comprar artículos en tiendas específicas.

items.name: Saeta
items.description: Moneda que circula de forma interna en la Alianza Xianzhou. La saeta es su unidad básica. Sirve para comprar artículos en tiendas específicas.

items.name: Combustible
items.description: Objeto que sirve para reponer el Poder trazacaminos. Restaura 60 pts. de Poder trazacaminos.

items.name: En nombre del mundo
items.description: "¿Welt...?". "Es un buen nombre... ¿verdad?". "Entonces...". "A partir de ahora, serás Welt". "Este núcleo de Herrscher... y la misión de proteger el mundo...". "Ahora son tuyos, Welt".

items.name: Noche en la Vía Láctea
items.description: Si te preocupa el estado del camino, mira al frente de nuevo. Cuando las estrellas nos contemplan, el corazón ya vuela en el viento. Cada pensamiento, cada susurro, se convierte en una experiencia vital que nunca se irá.

items.name: Algo insustituible
items.description: "Svarog, si algún día yo no estoy, tendrás que hacerte cargo de la base de datos". (¿Quién es? ¿Por qué hay un mensaje así en mis registros?). "Svarog, ¿hay algo que sea insustituible para ti?". (¿Insustituible?... Las piezas que se rompen se sustituyen y ya está...). "Svarog, algún día lo encontrarás". (Esas cosas... solo traerán problemas...). "Cuando llegue ese momento, vete de aquí".

items.name: El tiempo no espera
items.description: Había pasado muchos días al lado de la ventana. Afuera, las flores extendían orgullosamente sus pétalos mientras ella hacía remedios suaves con menta y nepeta. La lluvia caía mientras fabricaba remedios fuertes con mosla y jengibre. Las hojas volaban cuando mezclaba raíces de peonía y ciruelas secas para hacer remedios ácidos. La nieve caía cuando combinaba escutelaria y anemarrena para producir remedios amargos. El tiempo nunca se detiene, pero esta ventana y la persona sentada junto a ella siguen siendo las mismas.

items.name: La batalla no ha terminado
items.description: "Recuerden, la guerra contra esos monstruos no se puede ganar retirándose". "Detrás de nosotros está Belobog, nosotros somos la última línea de defensa...". "¡No podemos retirarnos bajo ninguna circunstancia!". Levantó la cabeza y miró la tierra helada y el invierno interminable. Otro día normal. Lo único diferente era que la espalda que solía contemplar ya no estaba.

items.name: El momento de la victoria
items.description: "Gepard, si quieres llorar cuando pierdas, hazlo". "Pero tienes que volver a levantarte hasta que puedas ganarme... aunque tardes cinco o diez años". Varios años después, el niño ya no lloraba ni perdía ante su hermana mayor. Hoy en día, y sin importar cuál sea la situación en el campo de batalla, el intrépido capitán de la Guardia Crinargenta se mantiene firme hasta el final... Para encontrar el momento exacto en el que aplastará a sus enemigos.

items.name: Dormir como un tronco
items.description: El joven sigue agarrando con fuerza la espada, incluso cuando se duerme apoyado en el hombro del general. Este roza la mejilla del joven, quien murmura algo en sueños. "General... por fin... gané...". El general se queda quieto y de repente se da cuenta de que, comparado con el joven, que cada día se esfuerza por mejorar, por él ya han pasado muchos años y se ha acostumbrado a no cambiar. "Muy pronto ganarás a todo el mundo, y eso solo será el comienzo...".

items.name: Solo hay que esperar
items.description: "¿Acaso hay algo que no me has contado?". Vio cómo su interlocutor tensaba el cuello y oyó cómo tragaba saliva. Ese hombre le tenía miedo, así que ni siquiera tenía que usar sus poderes. En realidad, no importaba lo que ella dijera. Cualquier palabra que saliera de su boca serviría para que el miedo comenzara a fermentar... Su interlocutor entraría en pánico inmediatamente y diría todo lo que ella quería oír. Solo necesitaba esperar, igual que una araña que ya ha extendido su tela.

characters.name: Trazacaminos
characters.description: Un joven que embarcó en el Expreso Astral. Decidió viajar con el Expreso Astral para eliminar las amenazas provocadas por el Estelaron.

characters.name: Himeko
characters.description:
Una científica aventurera que encontró el Expreso Astral varado en su planeta cuando era niña.
Varios años después, cuando Himeko al fin logró reparar el Expreso Astral y comenzó su viaje por el espacio, se dio cuenta de que ese no era más que el comienzo. En su nueva trayectoria como trazacaminos, iba a necesitar muchos compañeros...
Y aunque todos tengan destinos diferentes, todos observan el mismo cielo estrellado.

characters.name: Welt
characters.description:
Welt, el antiguo Soberano Antientropía, sabio y experimentado, heredó el nombre del mundo y lo salvó muchas veces de la aniquilación.
Cuando finalizó el incidente de St. Fontaine, Welt no tuvo más remedio que cruzar el portal con quien provocó ese incidente.
Probablemente, ni él mismo sabía que lo que le esperaba al otro lado era un nuevo viaje y nuevos compañeros.

characters.name: Siete de Marzo
characters.description:
Una chica vivaz y excéntrica apasionada por todo lo que interesa a las muchachas de su edad. Por ejemplo, tomar fotos...
Despertó tras pasar una eternidad dando vueltas por el espacio dentro de un bloque de hielo y desconoce todo lo relativo a su identidad y su pasado. Tras un breve periodo de desánimo, adoptó como nombre la fecha en la que renació.
Ese día, Siete de Marzo comenzó su nueva vida.

characters.name: Dan Heng
characters.description:
Un joven distante y reservado que blande una lanza llamada Perforanubes. Es el guardia del Expreso durante su larga expedición trazacaminos.
Dan Heng no habla mucho de su pasado. De hecho, se unió a la tripulación para escapar de él.
Pero ¿podrá el tren alejarlo de su pasado?

characters.name: Kafka
characters.description:
Kafka aparece en la lista de más buscados de la Corporación para la Paz Interastral, pero su entrada solo contiene dos datos: su nombre y la frase "Le gusta coleccionar abrigos". Apenas se sabe nada sobre esta Cazadora de Estelaron, aparte de que es una de las colaboradoras más cercanas de Elio, el Esclavo del Destino.
Kafka se pone en marcha para alcanzar el futuro que prevé Elio.

characters.name: Silver Wolf
characters.description:
El universo no es más que otro juego para esta hacker.
Silver Wolf puede traspasar fácilmente cualquier sistema de defensa, por complicado que sea. Su batalla de hacking con Tornillum, del Círculo de Genios, se ha convertido ya en una leyenda en su gremio.
¿Cuántas etapas más quedan por superar en el universo? Silver Wolf está deseando averiguarlo.

characters.name: Blade
characters.description:
Un espadachín que abandonó su cuerpo para convertirse en una espada. Se desconoce su nombre de nacimiento.
Juró lealtad al Esclavo del Destino y posee una terrorífica habilidad de autocuración.
Blade empuña una espada antigua llena de grietas, al igual que su cuerpo y su mente.

characters.name: Herta
characters.description:
La verdadera dueña de la Estación Espacial Herta.
Es la humana con mayor cociente intelectual de todo el Azul y solo se dedica a las cosas que le interesan. Cuando pierde el interés, el proyecto en el que estuviera inmersa cae inmediatamente en el olvido. La Estación Espacial es un buen ejemplo de ello.
Normalmente se muestra en forma de marioneta que, según Herta, se parece bastante a ella cuando era niña.

characters.name: Arlan
characters.description:
El jefe del Departamento de Seguridad de la Estación Espacial Herta. No es muy hablador.
Arlan no entiende de investigaciones científicas, pero está dispuesto a arriesgar su vida para proteger a los investigadores y que puedan completar su trabajo. Está acostumbrado al dolor y luce sus cicatrices como si fueran medallas.
Solo baja la guardia y muestra una sonrisa cuando juega con Peppy.

characters.name: Asta
characters.description:
Una joven muy curiosa y energética que también es la investigadora jefa de la Estación Espacial Herta.
Asta lo hace todo sin esfuerzo, ya se trate de lidiar con empleados obstinados o de responder a la Sociedad del Conocimiento con educación y firmeza.
Después de todo, ¡liderar una Estación Espacial es mucho más fácil que heredar una empresa familiar!

characters.name: Argenti
characters.description:
Un clásico caballero de los Caballeros de la Belleza.
Noble, cándido y franco. Viaja solo por el cosmos, siguiendo firmemente el camino de la Belleza.
Defender el honor de la Belleza en el universo es el deber de Argenti. Para cumplir con esta responsabilidad, debe entablar combate con piedad y hacer que el adversario admita la derrota tras golpear con su lanza.

characters.name: Topaz y Conti
characters.description:
Topaz, la experta del Departamento de Inversiones Estratégicas de la Corporación para la Paz Interastral y líder del equipo especial de fiscalización de deudas.
Es miembro de los Diez Corazones de Piedra desde muy joven y su especialidad es la recaudación de deudas.
Su compañero, un Chanchito Dimensional llamado Conti, es capaz de percibir con agudeza dónde hay riquezas, con lo que los trabajos relacionados con seguridad, cobro de deudas y procesos actuariales no suponen ningún problema.
Actualmente, viajan juntos por el cosmos investigando diversas deudas y obligaciones que pueden afectar negativamente al desarrollo de los negocios de la Corporación.

characters.name: Natasha
characters.description:
Una doctora muy meticulosa que siempre luce una curiosa sonrisa.
Los recursos médicos escasean en el Bajomundo, y Natasha es una de las pocas doctoras a la que pueden acudir sus habitantes.
Incluso la deslenguada Hook se comporta como una niña buena en su presencia.

characters.name: Hook
characters.description:
La jefa del grupo de aventureros Los Topos. Dice llamarse Gran Hook de la Oscuridad.
No le gusta que la llamen "niña" y piensa que puede encargarse de todo ella sola, sin la ayuda de ningún adulto.
Los adultos se aventuran en el Fragmentum, Sampo se aventura a la superficie y los pacientes van a Natasha para curarse las heridas que sufren durante sus aventuras... ¡Guiados por Hook, los niños también pueden vivir sus propias aventuras!

characters.name: Lynx
characters.description:
La más joven de la familia Landau, la mejor exploradora de Belobog.
Puede parecer indolente, pero en realidad es muy capaz. Muestra una actitud hermética solo para evitar socializar innecesariamente.
En cuanto a cómo define la socialización innecesaria: "Humm... ¿No son innecesarias todas las interacciones sociales?".

characters.name: Luka
characters.description:
Un luchador optimista y alegre que tiene un brazo robótico. Es miembro de Llamarada.
En el ring y en el campo de batalla, como boxeador y como luchador, Luka utiliza su poder para proteger a la gente del Bajomundo.
Él sabe lo que es perder la esperanza, así que está dispuesto a ayudar a los demás a recuperar la suya.

characters.name: Serval
characters.description:
La rebelde hija mayor de la familia Landau. Antes era la mejor amiga de Cocolia, y ahora lo que le interesa es la mecánica.
En el frío perpetuo de Belobog, Serval abrió un taller llamado Nuncainvierno que a menudo cierra para ofrecer conciertos de rock.
Si alguien preguntara si el taller resulta rentable, Serval contestaría: «Esto no es más que una afición. A mí me sobra el dinero».

characters.name: Pela
characters.description:
La meticulosa oficial de inteligencia de la Guardia Crinargenta. Es bastante joven, pero muy inteligente.
Pela responde a todas las cuestiones con una certeza calmada, ya estén relacionadas con las maniobras de las tropas, la distribución de los suministros o las condiciones del terreno.
En cuanto a la funda de su teléfono... «Eso no tiene nada que ver con el trabajo, capitán».

characters.name: Sampo
characters.description:
Un hombre de negocios con mucha labia y que siempre estará en cualquier lugar en el que se pueda sacar tajada.
La información que posee hace que no quede más remedio que contar con él, pero convertirse en su cliente no siempre es algo bueno.
Al fin y al cabo, un cliente puede convertirse en un producto si el precio es el adecuado.

characters.name: Gepard
characters.description:
El honorable y honrado capitán de la Guardia Crinargenta, descendiente de la aristocrática familia Landau.
En Belobog, la ciudad azotada por el frío, la vida puede continuar con normalidad...
Y en gran parte es gracias a que Gepard y sus Guardias Crinargenta garantizan la paz.

characters.name: Clara
characters.description:
Una niña criada por un robot. Su sensibilidad y su tenacidad son mayores de lo que cabría esperar por su edad.
Para Clara, los cálculos lógicos de Svarog son infalibles.
Hasta que se dio cuenta de que los resultados obtenidos tras esos cálculos no tienen por qué hacer feliz a la gente.
En ese momento, la niña tímida decidió armarse de valor.

characters.name: Bronya
characters.description:
La heredera de la Guardiana Suprema de Belobog. También es la joven pero competente comandante de la Guardia Crinargenta.
Desde pequeña, Bronya recibió una educación muy estricta y posee la conducta y la afinidad que se esperan de una heredera.
Pero, tras presenciar la situación lamentable del Bajomundo, la semilla de la duda comenzó a brotar en la mente de la futura gobernante de Belobog. «¿La formación que recibí realmente puede ayudar a la gente a conseguir la vida que quiere?».

characters.name: Seele
characters.description:
Una valiente miembro de Llamarada que creció en el entorno hostil del Bajomundo de Belobog. Está acostumbrada a estar sola.
Los protectores y los protegidos, los opresores y los oprimidos... El mundo en el que Seele creció era una dicotomía muy sencilla...
Hasta que apareció "esa chica".

characters.name: Jing Yuan
characters.description:
Aunque tenga pinta de perezoso, el general de los Nimbocaballeros que comanda el Luofu de Xianzhou es más meticuloso de lo que parece.
No considera que salvar una situación al borde del desastre sea una muestra de sabiduría, por lo que es muy escrupuloso con los asuntos rutinarios para evitar cualquier problema potencial.
Gracias a su cuidadosa gestión, Xianzhou ha disfrutado de muchos años de paz, y la apariencia aparentemente perezosa de Jing Yuan le ha hecho ganarse el apodo de "General Somnoliento".

characters.name: Yanqing
characters.description:
Un teniente de los Nimbocaballeros muy animoso, y también el espadachín más hábil del Luofu de Xianzhou.
Ha nacido para las espadas y está obsesionado con ellas. Siempre que una espada descansa en su mano, nadie se atreve a subestimar a este talento que aún se encuentra en la flor de la juventud.
Quizá lo único capaz de opacar el filo de su preciada espada sea el tiempo.

characters.name: Bailu
characters.description:
Una joven vivaz de la raza vidyadhara. Es conocida como la "Dama Sanadora" debido a sus vastos conocimientos de medicina.
Suele recetar medidas poco ortodoxas como "mantente bien hidratado" y "descansa mejor por la noche".
Bailu no soporta ver sufrir a la gente, y por eso mantiene los ojos cerrados mientras cura dolencias.
"Lo único que importa es que se curen, ¿no?".

characters.name: Tingyun
characters.description:
Tingyun es una raposiana elocuente y ostenta el cargo de aeroembajadora de Llamas Silbantes, el gremio de comerciantes de la Comisión del Transporte Celeste.
Su facilidad de palabra hace que su público espere ansiosamente más historias cautivadoras. Gracias a su supervisión, las ferias comerciales de Xianzhou se volvieron conocidas en toda la galaxia.
"Intentar evitar el conflicto siempre que sea posible, y persuadir a los que pueden ser persuadidos", ese es el lema de Tingyun.

characters.name: Sushang
characters.description:
Una ingenua y entusiasta novata de los Nimbocaballeros que empuña una pesada espada.
Anhela las leyendas históricas de los Nimbocaballeros y está ansiosa por convertirse ella misma en una figura similar.
Por ello, Sushang sigue firmemente las filosofías de "ayudar a los necesitados", "hacer una buena acción al día" y "reflexionar sobre una misma tres veces al día", lo que la lleva a tener unos días muy ocupados asistiendo a los demás.

characters.name: Qingque
characters.description:
Una adivinadora ordinaria de la Comisión de Adivinación que nunca flojea cuando se trata de holgazanear.
Aprobó el examen de acceso a la Comisión de Adivinación para complacer a sus padres, pero descubrió que lo que pensaba que era un trabajo relajado, en realidad era muy duro e intenso.
Tras varios años de experiencia, Qingque por fin ha perfeccionado sus habilidades. Pero no importa a qué departamento se cambie, sigue siendo la adivina de menor rango.
"¿Qué más podría desear en la vida que enterrar la cabeza en libros y jugar antiguos juegos de cartas?".

characters.name: Hanya
characters.description:
Es una de las juezas de la Comisión de los Diez Líderes en el Luofu. De las cuatro funciones de un juez (detener, encerrar, sentenciar e interrogar), Hanya se encarga de la última.
Está especializada en leer el karma y los pecados de los criminales. Luego, registra sus delitos y castigos con un pincel del oráculo.
Tras pasar tanto tiempo usando la oniromancia para predecir delitos kármicos y sufrir el desgaste causado por la ingente cantidad de información de los poseídos por Mara, se ha vuelto insensible a todo lo demás.
Solo cuando actúa junto a su compañera jueza y hermana, Xueyi, Hanya revela por un momento su verdadera naturaleza.

characters.name: Huohuo
characters.description:
Una muchacha raposiana lastimosa e indefensa que también es aprendiz de juez en la Comisión de los Diez Líderes y que debe atrapar fantasmas a pesar de tenerles miedo.
Un juez de la Comisión de los Diez Líderes selló en su cola un heliobus, el cual responde al nombre de Cola. Ahora carga con el título de "maldita" porque atrae el mal.
Teme a los demonios y espíritus malignos, pero siempre se le encomienda la ardua tarea de capturarlos y erradicarlos.
Aunque reconoce su falta de habilidades, no logra reunir el valor necesario para renunciar y sigue adelante a pesar de su miedo.

characters.name: Yukong
characters.description:
La jefa de la Comisión del Transporte Celeste del Luofu de Xianzhou, aunque experimentada y autoritaria, es amable.
Como piloto veterana desde una temprana edad, se había convertido en la líder de la Comisión gracias a sus extraordinarios logros, aunque ya no vuela debido a una batalla que fue especialmente despiadada.
Su brillo se había desvanecido ahora que había pasado a centrarse en tareas de gestión, pero siempre está de aquí para allá en el Luofu.

characters.name: Luocha
characters.description:
Un apuesto joven rubio que lleva un ataúd gigante a la espalda.
Como comerciante intergaláctico, desgraciadamente se vio atrapado en la crisis del Estelaron en el Luofu de Xianzhou.
Y así fue como descubrió que su dominio de la medicina le resultaba útil.

characters.name: Guinaifen
characters.description:
Una foránea que acabó residiendo en Xianzhou por accidente y ahora es una apasionada artista callejera.
Aunque su verdadero nombre es Guinevere, Guinaifen es el nombre de Xianzhou que le puso su buena amiga Sushang.
Se enfrenta a una nueva vida en el Luofu. Con su adoración por la cultura de Xianzhou como apoyo, Guinaifen aprendió rápidamente habilidades para mantenerse abrigada y alimentada, como comer fideos boca abajo, romper losas de piedra sobre el pecho de otros, atrapar proyectiles con las manos desnudas, etc.

characters.name: Jingliu
characters.description:
Una de los héroes legendarios que formaban el Quinteto Nube Alta y a la que se otorgó el título de "Destello Trascendental".
Al trascender los conceptos mortales de victoria, eligió recorrer un camino diferente para obtener el poder de matar dioses.
A partir de entonces, se eliminó a una maestra de espadas de los registros del Luofu de Xianzhou y se añadió a una traidora más cuyo nombre ha sido tachado.

characters.name: Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae
characters.description:
Dan Heng aceptó el poder de su vida anterior como Imbibitor Lunae y reveló la verdadera naturaleza de los vidyadhara.
Al aceptar la majestuosa corona de astas, también tuvo que adoptar todos los méritos y las faltas atribuidos a ese pecador.
Pero en ningún momento era él.

characters.name: Fu Xuan
characters.description:
La Gran Adivina de la Comisión de Adivinación del Luofu de Xianzhou. Una sabia que rebosa confianza y franqueza.
Es quien utiliza el tercer ojo y la Matriz del Presagio para predecir la ruta de Xianzhou y los resultados de los acontecimientos. Cree tajantemente que todo lo que hace es la "mejor solución" ante cualquier problema.
Fu Xuan no pierde la esperanza de que el general cumpla su promesa de abdicar. Sin embargo, ese día parece cada vez más lejano.

characters.name: Ruan Mei
characters.description:
Una erudita de carácter gentil y elegante. Es el miembro n.º 81 del Círculo de Genios, experta en el campo de las ciencias de la vida.
Se ganó la atención de Nous gracias a su talento y asombrosa dedicación. Comenzó su estudio y exploración del origen de la vida en un rincón secreto.
Para ese propósito, Herta la invitó a desarrollar el Universo Simulado de la mano de Tornillum y Stephen.
En secreto, disfruta mucho del teatro tradicional y los postres, y también está muy interesada en el bordado.

characters.name: Dr. Ratio
characters.description:
Erudito directo y egocéntrico de la Sociedad del Conocimiento. Suele ocultar su rostro con una extraña cabeza de escayola.
Ha demostrado un gran talento desde niño, pero ahora se autodenomina "mediocre".
Convencido de que la inteligencia y la creatividad no son exclusivas de los genios, se dedica a difundir el conocimiento en todo el cosmos para curar la persistente enfermedad llamada estupidez.

characters.name: Amione
characters.description: If one disappears, another simply shows up to take its place, and life goes on like nothing happened. For Amione, companionship is everything.

partnerSkill.name: Magical Twin Powers
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Watering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Anubis
characters.description: Once seen as a symbol of nobility, and an idol for those who shunned wealth and power. Yet over time, this pal became a token of death.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Desert
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, applies Ground damage to the player's attacks. Sometimes dodges attacks with a high speed sidestep while in battle.

characters.name: Arsox
characters.description: In ancient times, carnivorous Pals pursued them relentlessly. The absurd fury in the cries of Arsox transformed into a raging inferno, which has been passed on to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Warm Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Keeps the rider warm in cold environments.

characters.name: Astegon
characters.description: A savage beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.

alpha.name: Heat Resistant Refined Metal Armor Schematic 4

partnerSkill.name: Black Ankylosaur
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases the damage dealt to ores, and you can obtain more Ore while mounted.

characters.name: Azurmane
characters.description: Like Univolt, it was once believed to be connected to the Thunder God. As faith in Univolt waned, Azurmane was deemed the God's true envoy. Even so, time reduced both to the same lowly status of ordinary workhorses.

partnerSkill.name: Plasma Dash
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Also allows dashing in the air and moving at high speed.

characters.name: Azurobe
characters.description: This Pal's white ribbon turns black if doused with impure water. Given its usefulness in detecting poison, this Pal was once overhunted. This past has left them bitter towards humanity.

partnerSkill.name: Waterwing Dance
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water.

While mounted,
changes the player's attack type to {{Icon|Water}} and increases Attack by 5%.

characters.name: Azurobe Cryst
characters.description: This Pal’s white ribbon continuously absorbs heat from its surroundings, yet its temperature remains curiously unchanged. This strange ability once made it a target of relentless hunting, leaving it with a deep mistrust of humans to this day.

partnerSkill.name: Icewing Dance
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water.  Changes the player's attack type to Ice while mounted.

characters.name: Bakemi
characters.description: It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening. As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness, Bakemi now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.

partnerSkill.name: Grinning Death
partnerSkill.description: While in party, attacking enemies afflicted with Poison reduces their Attack. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Bastigor
characters.description: The sight of anything round gives it an uncontrollable urge to punch it. For Bastigor the toughest challenge, after simply living, is making a snowman.

partnerSkill.name: Blizzard Crash
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, delivers crushing blows with an Ice-forged hammer.

characters.name: Beakon
characters.description: Some think it is a related species to Ragnahawk, but there is in fact no connection. Using its sharp beak, it descends on its prey in a quick motion that resembles a bolt of lightning.

partnerSkill.name: Thunderous
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Electric while mounted.

characters.name: Beegarde
characters.description: A servant that pledges loyalty to Elizabee. Any that cause harm to the queen are immediately expelled from the hive. It will gladly give its life to protect its queen.

partnerSkill.name: Worker Bee
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Honey when assigned to the ranch. While in team, Elizabee's stats will be increased.

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Iris
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Nightmare Ray.

characters.name: Bellanoir Libero
characters.description: With her desires set loose, she was soon overwhelmed. she longed for a self to gaze upon herself. And the sisters who gazed, resenting reality, were driven into the abyss and, at last, closed their eyes.

uniqueCombos: Bellanoir Libero + Bellanoir Libero = Bellanoir Libero

partnerSkill.name: Nightmare Stare
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Nightmare Bloom.

characters.name: Blazamut
characters.description: Legends say it was born during a volcanic eruption. A strange group even claims that this continent is laid upon the back of a giant Blazamut.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Blazamut Ryu
characters.description: Long ago, it emerged from the depths of the earth. With relentless, raging flames showing no mercy, it burned the entire island until nothing remained. It was known as the Eternal Flame.

uniqueCombos: Blazamut Ryu + Blazamut Ryu = Blazamut Ryu

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Kaiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Dragon attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Blazehowl
characters.description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating well-done meat. This is due to its blistering claws, which it uses as its weapons- it simply doesn't realize its prey gets burred to a crisp.

partnerSkill.name: Hellflame Lion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, Grass Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Blazehowl Noct
characters.description: While it prefers raw meat, it always ends up eating tainted meat. This is due to its dark claws, which it uses as its weapon—it simply doesn't realize its prey gets cursed.

partnerSkill.name: Darkflame Lion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, Neutral Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Boltmane
characters.description: The more it moves, the more it heats up and the hair tips increasingly glow brighter. At its peak, it becomes so dazzling that you risk blindness if you stare at it directly.

characters.name: Braloha
characters.description: Its breath carries a miraculous, pollen-like substance that pollinates any plant it touches. For plant-based Pals, being near it can be a bit… complicated.

partnerSkill.name: Balmy Weather
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While at a base, shortens the time it takes Pals assigned to BreedFarm to produce eggs. (Effect does not stack.)

characters.name: Bristla
characters.description: This prickly Pal's thorns are highly poisonous. It is friendly with Cinnamoth and only smiles when a Cinnamoth is drinking its nectar.

partnerSkill.name: Princess Gaze
partnerSkill.description: While in team, increases Attack of Grass Pals.

characters.name: Broncherry
characters.description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma after finding a partner, which is called the "scent of first love."

partnerSkill.name: Love's First Blossom
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.

While in party,
Pal Eggs you pick up have a 35% chance of becoming an Alpha Pal Egg. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Broncherry Aqua
characters.description: Its scent drastically changes before and after pairing. It exudes a pleasing aroma before finding a partner, which is called the "perfume of purity"

partnerSkill.name: Overaffectionate
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Broncherry Aqua helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

characters.name: Bulldosu
characters.description: In the old islands, Bulldosu sumo was widely enjoyed. At the highest levels, even a charging Rushoar would be sent flying instead.

partnerSkill.name: Yokozuna's Presence
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
While in party, player and party Pals take less Electric damage and are immune to Electrify. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Bushi
characters.description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If someone other than a Bushi wields this blade, the soul within torments them until they are driven mad.

partnerSkill.name: Brandish Blade
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Iaigiri.

characters.name: Bushi Noct
characters.description: Its body becomes a blade upon death, to be taken up by the next generation. If the Bushi who inherits it has a weak heart, the voices of the dead will drive it mad. The madness turns it into Bushi Noct that endlessly wanders.

partnerSkill.name: Void Blade
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Iaigiri.

When this Pal uses Iaigiri, it has a x1.1 damage multiplier.

While in party,
increases the player's melee weapon damage by 30% but only when not in combat. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Caprity
characters.description: The shrub on this Pal's back produces berries as long as it is properly fed. It offers these berries to potential mates, and if the flavor is to their liking, romance blossoms.

partnerSkill.name: Berry Picker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Red Berries from its back when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Caprity Noct
characters.description: The berries that grow on its back change flavor according to its emotions. The harsher the environment it grows in, the sweeter the berries become. This is why most Caprity Noct raised in captivity have never known love.

partnerSkill.name: Venom Picker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Venom Gland from its back when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Carnibora
characters.description: Prone to eating indiscriminately, the mouth atop its head frequently breaks out in agonizing ulcers, causing it to use the mouth on its face instead. However, its behavior doesn't change, which leads to both mouths suffering the same ulcers.

partnerSkill.name: Entangling Tongue
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player performs a dodge roll or dodge step, Carnibora creates a whirlwind that deals Grass damage to enemies it touches. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Cattiva
characters.description: At a glance it appears confident, but it is in fact weak and cowardly. Being toyed with by Cattiva is in many ways the greatest of disgraces.

partnerSkill.name: Cat Helper
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Cattiva helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity by 100. (Does not stack.)

characters.name: Cawgnito
characters.description: Long ago it freely soared the skies. After losing a contest with Galeclaw, it abandoned the skies, and now lives a secretive life in the dark of night.

partnerSkill.name: Telepeck
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Phantom Peck.

characters.name: Celaray
characters.description: Riding the wind, this Pal travels where it pleases. Should it find a partner along the way, the encounter will mark its journey's end.

partnerSkill.name: Zephyr Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

characters.name: Celaray Lux
characters.description: Its flashy patterns help it attract a partner. But after a long history of electrocution incidents involving Celeray Lux, yellow-and-black stripes are now seen across the island as a sign of danger.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in party, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Prevents fall damage and extends the duration of high-speed gliding.

characters.name: Celesdir
characters.description: Ancient texts refer to it as the "Beast of Salvation." The light emitted by Celesdir purifies everything, literally causing things to vanish from existence without leaving a trace.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of Purification
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Increases the player's auto recovery speed while mounted.

characters.name: Chikipi
characters.description: Extremely weak and far too delicious. It is one of the weakest Pals alongside Lamball. No matter how many are hunted, they just keep appearing.

partnerSkill.name: Egg Layer
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes lays an Egg when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Chillet
characters.description: It can curl its body and roll around at extremely high speeds. Long ago, people would tie bags of milk to domesticated Chillet as they grazed to produce butter using this spinning force.

partnerSkill.name: Wriggling Weasel
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Dragon while mounted.

characters.name: Chillet Ignis
characters.description: When curled up it spins so fast that sparks fly. Sparks also fly when it feels excited. If you stroke it too much, sparks fly!

partnerSkill.name: Sparkling Weasel
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Fire while mounted.

characters.name: Cinnamoth
characters.description: Sniffing its scales produces a feeling of unparalleled euphoria. There was some effort to further regulate this byproduct, but the Free Pal Alliance have vehemently opposed these measures, putting a stop to them.

partnerSkill.name: Mysterious Scales
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks the targeted enemy with Poison Fog. While at a base, increases the Farming Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Clovee
characters.description: Some individuals once had three or more leaves on their foreheads. Regarded as symbols of good fortune, those with more leaves were heavily hunted, leading the species to evolve fewer leaves over time.

partnerSkill.name: Happy Clover
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Gathering Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Cremis
characters.description: Compared to Lamball, it has finer wool and a temperament more suited for domestication. However, it has historically always been kept as a pet. Cuteness is considered a virtue.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Wool
partnerSkill.description: While in team, increases Attack of Neutral Pals. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Croajiro
characters.description: Those who disgrace the honor of the herd are forced to take their own life. By piercing their inflated vocal sac with a tree branch, they are blown away into the atmosphere and return to the afterlife.

partnerSkill.name: Leap Stance
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Croajiro swells its abdomen and channels its loyalty to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air.

While airborne before landing,
the player's Attack is increased by 50%.

characters.name: Croajiro Noct
characters.description: The Croajiro who have fosaken their honor gather and form splinter groups. They will use any underhanded means to take down their choosen prey. If you encounter a pack of Croajiro Noct in the dead of the night, it's your life that's on the line.

partnerSkill.name: Shadow Stance
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Croajiro Noct channels its loyalty and puffs up its abdomen to store energy. Climbing on top will propel the player high into the air.


While in party,
improves player's and Pals' {{Icon|Dark}} damage to enemy weak points by 25%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Cryolinx
characters.description: It can easily climb steep mountains with its hard claws. However, its short legs make it difficult to descend, often leaving it stranded in high places.

partnerSkill.name: Dragon Hunter
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Dragon Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Cryolinx Terra
characters.description: It can easily carry many items with its large hands. However, its short legs slow its pace, often leaving it overtaken by nightfall.

partnerSkill.name: Electro Hunter
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Electric Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Daedream
characters.description: It puts those it is interested in to sleep and shows them an endless stream of happy dreams. Those who fall under its spell are never to wake until death takes them.

partnerSkill.name: Dream Chaser
partnerSkill.description:
While in team, appears near the player.

Attacks hostile enemies with Dark magic bullets.
These bullets will not reduce the target's Health below 1.

characters.name: Dark Mutant
characters.description: Some say a beam from a Dark Mutant that has perfected its technique can tear holes into other dimensions. It's even believed that certain species of Pals were born from such phenomena.

characters.name: Dazemu
characters.description: Take one step forward and forget your doubts. Take two steps forward and forget your worries. Take three steps forward and forget your fears. Face any enemy.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Sprint
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Runs faster over sand.

characters.name: Dazzi
characters.description: Often kind to lonely pals. However, the moment a pal mistakes this for actual companionship it seizes the opportunity to blast them with a thunderbolt.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in team, appears near the player. Follows up player attacks with lightning bolts.

characters.name: Dazzi Noct
characters.description: Often kind to lonely Pals, it plots to lure them into dropping their guard before striking them down. Yet, unable to find the right moment, it ends up making friends with them instead.

partnerSkill.name: Lady of Dark Lightning
partnerSkill.description: While in team, appears near the player. Follows up player attacks with dark lightning bolts.

characters.name: Depresso
characters.description: It has few friends because of the perpetually grouchy look on its face, but it is in fact kindhearted. Some have seen it feeding Vixy who have strayed from their pack.

partnerSkill.name: Caffeine Inoculation
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Depresso chugs an entire energy drink, increasing its Movement Speed and Work Speed by 100%.

Sometimes drops Venom Gland when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Digtoise
characters.description: A walking contradiction, possessing the strongest shell and the only drill capable of piercing it. "Digtoise's Fable" is a popular children's tale.

partnerSkill.name: Drill Crusher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, enters the Shell Spin state.  Follows the player while spinning, increasing ore mining efficiency by 800%.

characters.name: Dinossom
characters.description: A Pal who once angered cannot be pacified. It rages on and on like an inferno. The phrase "step on a Dinossom's tail" has come to mean enraging someone.

partnerSkill.name: Fragrant Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Grass attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Dinossom Lux
characters.description: Though struck by lightning, it lives on. The phrase "struck by a Dinossom Lux's bolt" has come to mean narrowly escaping death.

partnerSkill.name: Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Electric attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Direhowl
characters.description: Long ago Direhowl would hunt alongside humans but over the years this bond faded.

partnerSkill.name: Direhowl Rider
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Moves slightly faster than most mounts.

characters.name: Dogen
characters.description: Striving for a state of selflessness, it meditates endlessly. After confronting its worldly desires, it eats a meal and reflects. It ate too much today.

partnerSkill.name: Homeward Prayer
partnerSkill.description: When activated, moves to the closest base. Cannot be used within dungeons, etc.

characters.name: Dragostrophe
characters.description: A silent beast born of the abyss. Thou shall not stand before the beast. Thou shall not heed the beast.

characters.name: Dualith
characters.description: One entity, two minds. When their wills clash, it's impossible to tell where the armor will wander until they reconcile.

partnerSkill.name: Forest Laser
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
When activated, Dualith fires a powerful Grass laser from its right hand.

characters.name: Dualith Noct
characters.description: One entity, two minds. They rarely agree and bicker constantly, but once battle begins, mind and body instantly unite as one!

partnerSkill.name: Corruption Laser
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
When activated, Dualith fires a powerful Dark laser from its right hand.

characters.name: Dumud
characters.description: When too relaxed, its reaction time drastically declines. Even if it were sliced from head to tail, it probably wouldn't even realize that it should be dead until the next morning.

partnerSkill.name: Soil Improver
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of {{icon|Ground}} Pals by 15%.  Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Dumud Gild
characters.description: Its body reflects light with astounding clarity. Even more shocking, its reflexes are somehow even slower than Dumud.

partnerSkill.name: Golden Harvest
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases the amount of Gold Coin dropped by enemies by +100%.


Sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil when assigned to Ranch, with a small chance to drop Gold Coin. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Dupin
characters.description: A copy it created might quietly replace it, leaving even the Dupin itself unsure whether it is still the original.

partnerSkill.name: Trick-Loving Fluffle
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player's Health falls below 50%, Dupin generates an explosion around the player. Additionally, while the player's Health is below 50%, the player's Attack is increased. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Dynamoff
characters.description: With so little to eat at high altitudes, it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains. It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into Beakon.

partnerSkill.name: Electro-Massage Incubation
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While at a base, shortens the time it takes to incubate eggs. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Eidrolon
characters.description: A new Pal that was only recently discovered. Calm and entirely docile, it spends its time as it pleases. It is no longer bound by anything.

partnerSkill.name: Liberated Pterosaur
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount.
This Pal's Attack and Movement Speed increase for each other Dragon or Dark Pal in your party.

characters.name: Eikthyrdeer
characters.description: The one who possesses the most impressive antlers becomes the leader of the herd. If their antlers are broken, they become depressed and leave the herd, never to be seen again.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Forest
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden. 
Can perform a double jump while mounted and increases lumbering efficiency by 220%.

characters.name: Eikthyrdeer Terra
characters.description: The individual with the hardest horns becomes the leader. Once the horns are lost, so too is its leadership status. It leaves the herd amidst farewell glances and quietly returns to the earth.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Golden Forest
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. Increases efficiency of cutting trees.

characters.name: Elgrove
characters.description: The leaf on its horn cannot be removed, no matter how hard it is pulled. When the leaf falls on its own, Elgrove accepts its time has come.

characters.name: Elizabee
characters.description: A chosen queen to rule over Beegardes. There is a never ending stream of servants willing to work themselves to death for the pleasure of serving their queen.

partnerSkill.name: Queen Bee Command
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, stats will increase the more Beegarde are in your team.

characters.name: Elphidran
characters.description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it is sometimes unable to discern good from evil, often allowing wrongdoers to take advantage of it.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Holy Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. While fighting together, Dark Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Elphidran Aqua
characters.description: It possesses a demeanor as pure as its appearance suggests. Perhaps because of this, it harbors no ill will in any of its actions and is indifferent even after killing someone.

partnerSkill.name: Amicable Water Dragon
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. 


While in party, player and party Pals take 15% less Fire damage and are immune to Burn. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Faleris
characters.description: When it finds its prey it unleashes a whirlwind of flames, burning the entire area to ash. Faleris breath is known for its pleasing scent.

partnerSkill.name: Scorching Predator
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While fighting together, Ice Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Faleris Aqua
characters.description: When it finds its prey, it unleashes a mighty torrent, sweeping the entire area. More often than not, the prey gets swept away in the chaos, leaving one to wonder whether this truly counts as hunting.

partnerSkill.name: Tidal Predator
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While fighting together, Fire Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Felbat
characters.description: Attacking from the shadows, this pal traps its prey within its cloak-like wigs. It's probably best not to know what happens within them, or why the inside of its wings are stained red.

partnerSkill.name: Life Steal
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Felbat the life steal effect which absorbs some of the received damage and restores Health.

characters.name: Fenglope
characters.description: In ages past, its beautiful visage was a common sight in paintings. As time passed, its beautiful pelts and antlers where often seen in works of art.

partnerSkill.name: Wind and Clouds
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

characters.name: Fenglope Lux
characters.description: In ages past, it was believed that drawing a picture of Fenglope Lux would result in being struck down by lightning. As time passes, artworks depicting Fenglope Lux became revered as charms to ward off lightning, making them a common presence.

partnerSkill.name: Stormcloud
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. While fighting together, Water Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Finsider
characters.description: It looks like something is peeking out from inside a costume, but even if you reach inside, there’s nothing there. In fact, you can keep reaching deeper and deeper. Perhaps the universe itself lies within.

partnerSkill.name: Echo Chamber
partnerSkill.description: While in team, Finsider helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of weapons in the player's inventory.

characters.name: Finsider Ignis
characters.description: Even if you reach into its mouth, there’s nothing inside—it just keeps going. Thinking it might be an interdimensional space, one researcher tried climbing in like a sleeping bag. But when the gag reflex kicked in, they realized... it’s definitely part of the creature’s body.

partnerSkill.name: Ember Chamber
partnerSkill.description: While in team,  Finsider Ignis helps carry supplies,  decreasing the weight of weapons  in the player's inventory.  Also increases Attack of Fire Pals.

characters.name: Flambelle
characters.description: When it starts crying, this Pal produces magma in place of tears. The magma that pours out is absorbed back into its body, causing it to get hotter and hotter. The more it cries, the stronger it becomes.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Tears
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, recovers Health of the player and Party Pals by 0.1% per second outside of combat. (Does not stack)


Sometimes produces Flame Organ when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Flaracle
characters.description: It focuses its mind and reads the future through flames. Should it glimpse an inconvenient destiny, it relentlessly rerolls the prophecy until it gets a favorable result. That is why the future of Flaracle is always exceptionally bright!

partnerSkill.name: Burning Future
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Burn, the enemy explodes, dealing damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

characters.name: Flopie
characters.description: It prefers places that have an abundance of vegetation, but hay fever has apparently become a problem for Flopie as of late.

partnerSkill.name: Helper Bunny
partnerSkill.description: While in team, appears near the player. Automatically picks up nearby items.

characters.name: Foxcicle
characters.description: On nights when the aurora is visible, it looks up towards the sky and begins to howl a beautiful song. This does, however, leave it vulnerable to attacks from enemies.

partnerSkill.name: Aurora Guide
partnerSkill.description: While in team, increases Attack of Ice Pals. Sometimes drops Ice Organ when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Foxparks
characters.description: It is unskilled at controlling fire from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the flames it breathes unintentionally. Foxparks sneezes are one of the leading causes of forest fires.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Fire
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into a flamethrower.

characters.name: Foxparks Cryst
characters.description: It is unskilled at controlling cold air from the moment it is born and tends to choke on the frost it breathes unintentionally. When Foxparks Cryst catches a cold, its nasal discharge freezes, making it difficult to breathe and causing it to panic.

partnerSkill.name: Huggy Frost
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and attacks using frigid air.

characters.name: Frostallion
characters.description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island, known as the Winter Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into an eternal winter.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Steed
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Ice and enhances Ice attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Frostallion Noct
characters.description: Guardian deity of Palpagos Island known as the Night Caller. In the past, when a calamity struck the land, it soared into the sky and sealed away the threat by casting the island into eternal darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Steed
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Dark and enhances Dark attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Frostplume
characters.description: So precise is its sense of time that it awakens at the exact same hour every morning. According to Palpagos lore, a day was divided into 24 parts because when Frostplume spreads its tail feathers wide, it reveals a pattern with 24 distinct spaces.

partnerSkill.name: Peacock Pounce
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Frostplume's icy aura sharpens your focus, improving reload speed.

characters.name: Fuack
characters.description: Using its own body water, this pal can create waves anywhere. its body surfs when in a hurry, but the resulting speed often ends in a fatal collision.

partnerSkill.name: Surfing Slam
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Fuack body surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.

characters.name: Fuack Ignis
characters.description: With a belly built for friction, this Pal sparks flames as it body surfs. But when it gets carried away, it often ends up a rolling fireball.

partnerSkill.name: Fire Tackle
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Fuack Ignis fire surfs towards an enemy and slams into them.

characters.name: Fuddler
characters.description: Its large claws boast diamond-like hardness. However, sharpening these claws consumes most of its energy, leading it to sometimes spend entire days doing nothing else.

partnerSkill.name: Mining Assistance
partnerSkill.description: When in party,improves player mining efficiency by 30% and reduces Stone weight by 80%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Galeclaw
characters.description: A pal that can easily take flight even when grasping a human. it is, however, prone to letting go when tired, which has led to the sudden demise of more then a few souls.

partnerSkill.name: Galeclaw Glider
partnerSkill.description: While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider.  Enables high-speed gliding and allows shooting with the right hand.

characters.name: Ghangler
characters.description: With its shining lure, it illuminates the darkness. The wandering Pals drawn in by the light stand no chance of escape once spotted by Ghangler. No matter how far, it will keep guiding them until they get home safe and sound.

partnerSkill.name: Master Night Angler
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel quickly across water. While fighting together, the time it takes for Pals to bite during night fishing is reduced.

characters.name: Ghangler Ignis
characters.description: Its blazing lure doubles as a grill for roasting prey. Drawn in by the delicious aroma, Pals have no hope of escape once Ghangler Ignis sets its sights on them. In the end, they’re treated to a hearty meal—until everyone’s full.

partnerSkill.name: Flame Lantern
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel quickly across water. While fighting together, the time it takes for Pals to bite during night fishing is reduced.

characters.name: Gildane
characters.description: During the golden age of alchemy on the island, its ever-glowing golden fur was highly prized as a catalyst for transmuting gold. In time, a remarkable revelation was made: the same golden hue could be achieved simply by processing its mane.

partnerSkill.name: Sandstorm's Blessing
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Ground while mounted.

characters.name: Gildra
characters.description: The golden, bandage-like organs covering its body are highly elastic. However, they are prone to tearing under extremely dry conditions, so daily moisture checks are absolutely essential.

partnerSkill.name: Resurrection
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, when Gildra is incapacitated, it revives with its Hunger reduced to 0.

characters.name: Gloopie
characters.description: Be sure to check your plans for the next day before falling asleep with this Pal. Its suction cups leave marks that look suspiciously like hickeys. One sleepy cuddle session could lead to some truly awkward misunderstandings.

partnerSkill.name: Sticky Princess
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together,  the capture gauge decreases more slowly  in the fishing minigame  when the bar is not aligned.

characters.name: Gobfin
characters.description: Long ago, it was a large and powerful aquatic Pal. As food become scarce, it evolved to live on land. Since walking requires much energy, it gradually became smaller and is now a small and puny Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Aqua Gun. 

When this Pal uses Aqua Gun, it has a 1.1x multiplier.

While in party, increases the player's Attack by 10%.

characters.name: Gobfin Ignis
characters.description: Once upon a time, it was a giant and powerful aquatic Pal. However, with the dwindling availability of food, it ventured onto land. As a consequence of burning many calories to walk, it astonishingly awakened its power to control fire!

partnerSkill.name: Angry Shark
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Spirit Fire. While in team, increases player's Attack.

characters.name: Gorirat
characters.description: It beats the ground rhythmically to communicate with its comrades. The meaning of each rhythm differs by troop, but the distinction between them is still largely unknown.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, unleashes a primal fury that increases Gorirat's Attack by 75% for a limited time.

characters.name: Gorirat Terra
characters.description: It communicates with its friends through rhythmic tapping on the ground. Stronger than Gorirat. If every Gorirat Terra hit the ground at the same time, the island would sink in 1 second.

partnerSkill.name: Full-Power Gorilla Mode
partnerSkill.description:
While in party,
increases the player's climbing speed by 50-100%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Grintale
characters.description: Grintale's eyes light up the moment anyone enters its territory. This is no figure of speech - its eyes literally light up.

partnerSkill.name: Glaring Cat's Eye
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, picking up a Pal Egg has a 50% chance of receiving one extra. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Grizzbolt
characters.description: With a friendly smile and a hardy physique, it is docile towards one it recognizes as a partner. For reasons unexplained, its personality undergoes a drastic change when wielding a minigun.

partnerSkill.name: Yellow Tank
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a minigun while mounted.

characters.name: Gumoss
characters.description: A strange pal with a body resembling tree sap. It gradually loses strength if it has nothing to cover its body with, eventually rotting away.

partnerSkill.name: Logging Assistance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, improves logging efficiency by 30% and reduces weight of all types of wood by 40%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Hangyu
characters.description: Its strong arms can rip apart even iron. As a particularly cruel form of execution, serious criminals would be strung up in a public square, and a Hangyu would rip off the skin from their bones.

partnerSkill.name: Flying Trapeze
partnerSkill.description: While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascent while gliding.

characters.name: Hangyu Cryst
characters.description: Its gigantic arms can tear through blocks of ice. There were times when great sinners were tied in the town square and had their hair torn out by Hangyu Cryst as a brutal form of public humiliation.

partnerSkill.name: Winter Trapeze
partnerSkill.description: While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables slow ascent while gliding.

characters.name: Hartalis
characters.description: The silence is unsettling, yet strangely soothing. No one else remains. All have been delivered. O King of Salvation, carry me too into eternal stillness. -The ancient text cuts off here.

partnerSkill.name: Sacred Barrier
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, generates a barrier that blocks all attacks. Can triple jump while mounted.

characters.name: Helzephyr
characters.description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. One who dies from Helzephyr's inferno is sure to be sent to the underworld.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Death
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Dark while mounted.

characters.name: Helzephyr Lux
characters.description: It calls forth lightning from the depths of hell. While considered a subspecies of Helzephyr, there's a theory that suggests Helzephyr Lux, struck by lightning from hell, will transform into Helzephyr.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Thunder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Changes the player's attack type to Electric while mounted.

characters.name: Herbil
characters.description: When in doubt, punch it till it works-that's Herbil's approach to fixing things. With strength perfectly tuned for humans, sometimes just one punch is enough to restart a stopped heart.

partnerSkill.name: Herbil Pulse
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Herbil uses its healing powers to restore 30% of the player's Max Health when incapacitated.

characters.name: Hoocrates
characters.description: Often lost in thought, it sometimes finds it difficult to sleep. "I think, therefore I am."

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knowledge

characters.name: Hoodle
characters.description: When it sleeps, it deflates. When it sleeps, it's no longer there. A sleeping Hoodle cannot exist; Therefore, Hoodle never sleeps.

partnerSkill.name: Void-Dweller
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's damage dealt to enemies that are not in combat. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Icelyn
characters.description: Though its body melts in the heat, it just can’t resist sunbathing. Though its body melts in the warmth, it likes hot springs too much. If it's going to melt anyway, it hopes it’ll be in a steaming outdoor bath under a clear blue sky.

partnerSkill.name: Witch's Icy Veil
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Ice.

characters.name: Incineram
characters.description: In the dark of night, this Pal snatches prey to bring back to its territory. What happens to those poor souls afterwards isn't too hard to imagine.

partnerSkill.name: Flameclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Hellfire Claw.

characters.name: Incineram Noct
characters.description: It specifically targets baby pals, taking them back to its territory. One can only imagine the profound despair of the parent Pal, whose child has been taken away.

partnerSkill.name: Darkclaw Hunter
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Hellfire Claw.

characters.name: Jelliette
characters.description: A Pal that closely resembles Jellroy. It’s very social, so when plans overlap, it asks its good friend Jellroy to go in its place. As thanks, one date.

partnerSkill.name: Jelliette Drop
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases items obtained from fishing by 55%.  While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jelliette's watering speed increases by 50%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Jellroy
characters.description: A Pal that closely resembles Jelliette. It sometimes appears as a substitute when Jelliette is unavailable. Its acting is so flawless that no one ever notices the switch.

partnerSkill.name: Jellroy Drop
partnerSkill.description: While in party,increases items obtained from salvaging by 55%.While Jelliette and Jellroy are in your base, Jellroy's watering speed increases by 50%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Jetragon
characters.description: Watches over Palpagos Island from high above. When calamity returns to the land, the earth will split open, and the skies will burn. It is destined to strike down the calamity in a flash of total destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Missile
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

characters.name: Jolthog
characters.description: Releases the electricity stored in its body when under attack, producing a shock that can be over 10 million volts. If thrown, it can even be more lethal than any conventional heavy weaponry.

partnerSkill.name: Jolt Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips Jolthog to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Electric explosion upon impact.

characters.name: Jolthog Cryst
characters.description: It releases the cold air stored in its body when under attack. The frigid blast it radiates is cold enough to freeze the surrounding air and easily pierces through any attacker's body.

partnerSkill.name: Cold Bomb
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips Jolthog Cryst to the player to be thrown at an enemy, causing an Ice explosion upon impact.

characters.name: Jormuntide
characters.description: Legend says that the Jormuntide was once a wise man, who after being wrongly convicted and cast into a whirlpool, returned as this Pal to destroy those who wronged him.

partnerSkill.name: Stormbringer Sea Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden to travel on water. While mounted, prevents stamina depletion while moving on water.

characters.name: Jormuntide Ignis
characters.description: Legend says the Jormuntide Ignis was once a warrior who, after being wrongly convicted and cast into a volcano, returned as this Pal to destroy those who wronged him.

partnerSkill.name: Stormbringer Lava Dragon
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Katress
characters.description: With the power of shadows, it produces arcane phenomena. It prefers to eat food raw and is particularly hostile towards Wixen.

partnerSkill.name: Grimoire Collector
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Neutral Pals drop more items when defeated. Also has a 10% chance to prevent Pal Sphere consumption when thrown. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Katress Ignis
characters.description: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is raw enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as spicy as possible. Not on good terms with Wixen Noct.

partnerSkill.name: Blazing Black magic
partnerSkill.description: While at base, increase the Kinding Work Suitabilty Level for all othe Base Pals by +1

characters.name: Kelpsea
characters.description: Its personality changes depending on the quality of the water it was born into. Kelpsea born into polluted waters are generally ill-tempered and quickly become delinquents.

partnerSkill.name: Aqua Spout
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases Attack of Water Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)


Sometimes drops Aquatic Pal Fluids when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Kelpsea Ignis
characters.description: Their personalities change depending on the temperature of the water where they were born. Kelpsea born in warm waters generally have a passionate, motivated personality.

partnerSkill.name: Lava Spout
partnerSkill.description: While in team, increases Attack of Fire Pals. Sometimes drops Flame Organ when assigned to the ranch.

partnerSkill.name: Rollin' Full Oil
partnerSkill.description: While in team, Kikit helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of crude oil in the player's inventory.

characters.name: Killamari

partnerSkill.name: Fried Squid
partnerSkill.description: While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider. Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

characters.name: Killamari Primo
characters.description: It sinks its fangs into the enemy's neck, draining every last drop of blood. When two Killamari Primos latch onto each other, they become locked in a relentless struggle-each trying to suck the other dry until one withers away.

partnerSkill.name: Fried Killamari
partnerSkill.description: While in team, modifies the performance of the equipped glider.  Enables gentle floating while gliding for an extended time.

characters.name: Kingpaca
characters.description: Melpaca serve this pal. Contests between Kingpaca offer up their vassals as a wager. Those seen alone are losers of such contests.

partnerSkill.name: King of Muscles
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Kingpaca helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

characters.name: Kingpaca Cryst
characters.description: With a heart of ice, this Pal is terrible at expressing its emotions. A solitary individual is pitiable, seen as too clumsy in the eyes of a Melpaca.

partnerSkill.name: King of Muscles
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Kingpaca Cryst helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

characters.name: Kitsun
characters.description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun is extremely sensitive and will flee to a cave when spooked. Long ago, it was considered an ill omen if one were found nearby.

partnerSkill.name: Wolf of the Sun

characters.name: Kitsun Noct
characters.description: Despite its appearance, Kitsun Noct is extremely sensitive and will flee into a cave when spooked. It has become quite gloomy from being a shut-in for too long.

partnerSkill.name: Fogged Mind
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Dark while mounted.

characters.name: Knocklem
characters.description: Can be disassembled into 215 parts, and even if the parts are scattered, it will reassemble itself and start moving again. If parts from different individuals are mixed it will malfunction due to mistaken identity.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Guardian Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, a steel resolve increases Knocklem's Attack and Defense for a limited time.

characters.name: Lamball
characters.description: A walk up a hill tends to end with this Pal tumbling back down. This causes it to become dizzy and unable to move, making it easy to capture and kill. As a result, this Pal has tumbled down to the very bottom of the food chain itself.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Shield
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and becomes a shield. Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Lapiron
characters.description: Listens to the earth as it runs, avoiding unstable footing with ease. However, uncooperative terrain will trick it into falling over constantly.

partnerSkill.name: Friend of Earth
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's Defense while sprinting. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Lapure
characters.description: It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained. Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.

partnerSkill.name: Long-Sleeved Hurray
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the Partner Skill cooldowns for other party Pals. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Leafan
characters.description: To hone the martial art passed down through a single bloodline: Daily training is the only way! Being distracted by romance? Unthinkable! Daily discipline is the only way! The time has come! Shoot my shot! Instant rejection, that’s all there is! The techniques of love were never passed down... Lingering regret, that’s all there is!

partnerSkill.name: Selfless Discipline
partnerSkill.description: This Pal's Attack and Defense increase by 2% for each other Grass Pal in your party.

characters.name: Leezpunk
characters.description: A Pal that always takes great care to maintain a stylish stance. Always on the hunt for the coolest poses, if given a mirror it will spend all day posing in front of it.

partnerSkill.name: Sixth Sense
partnerSkill.description: When activated, utilizes its sixth sense to detect nearby dungeons.

characters.name: Leezpunk Ignis
characters.description: A Pal that has an unusual obsession with their standing posture. Always in search of the hottest pose, this Pal's owner is constantly presented with fervent stances.

partnerSkill.name: Sixth Sense

characters.name: Lifmunk
characters.description: Intelligent as a five to seven-year-old human child. It makes a wonderful partner, but there have been more then a few cases where they've killed their master after learning to use weapons.

partnerSkill.name: Lifmunk Recoil
partnerSkill.description: When activated, leaps onto the player's head and uses a submachine gun to follows up player attacks.

characters.name: Loomen
characters.description: Its lantern glows with an eerie light that lays bare the truth of the world. If that light strikes you as blinding, then you most likely have something to hide.

partnerSkill.name: Lantern Enchantment
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's arrows explode on contact, dealing additional damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Loupmoon
characters.description: The horns on its head grow under the moonlight. It doesn't hate the sun, but its horns itch when sunlight hits them.

partnerSkill.name: Dark Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Jumping Claw.

characters.name: Loupmoon Cryst
characters.description: The horns on its head are made of a mysterious ice that never melts. Shaved ice made by breaking off a horn is truly exquisite, but both the one who tries it and Loupmoon Cryst end up with a headache.

partnerSkill.name: Frozen Gleam Strike
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with Snow Claw. When this Pal uses Snow Claw, it has a 1.1x damage multiplier.  While in party, increases the player's [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Weapons#:~:text=Melee%20Weapons,-%5Bedit melee weapon] attack speed by 15%

characters.name: Lovander
characters.description: Seeking a night of love, it is always chasing someone around. At first it only showed interest in other Pals, but in recent years even humans have become the target of its debauchery.

partnerSkill.name: Heart Drain
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, grants the player and Lovander a life steal effect that restores 5% of damage dealth as Health..

characters.name: Lullu

partnerSkill.name: Floral Boost
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, Lullu fills the farm with good spirits, increasing the growth rate of the crops.

characters.name: Lunaris
characters.description: It can control those who carelessly stare into its eyes. Those seen with a Lunaris are in its mind, simply under its control.

partnerSkill.name: Antigravity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, spheres hone in on Pals, and carrying capacity increases by 300. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Lyleen
characters.description: A docile Pal full of love. It watches over small Pals who have lost their parents. It uses a full-power Solar Blast to discipline naughty Pals.

partnerSkill.name: Harvest Goddess
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  the queen's soothing graces greatly restore the player's Health.

characters.name: Lyleen Noct
characters.description: An elegant Pal full of grace. It admonishes any who are disrespectful with a painful slap. Some Pals actively seek out this punishment.
