partnerSkill.name: Goddess of the Tranquil Light
partnerSkill.description: When activated,  the queen's soothing graces greatly restore the player's Health.

characters.name: Majex
characters.description: It appears to be striking a heroic pose, but the reality is that it's simply bracing itself against the weight of its tail and hair to avoid toppling over.

partnerSkill.name: Phantasmal Arcana
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Status_Effects#Burn:~:text=Burn,-%5Bedit Burn], the enemy creates flames around itself, dealing continuous damage equal to 15% of the player's attack damage to enemies that come into contact with them. (Does not stack.)

characters.name: Mammorest
characters.description: The vegetation on its back varies between individuals. There is a long history of appreciating this veritable garden of a Pal, and there are even Mammorest pruning specialists.

partnerSkill.name: Gaia Crusher
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of cutting trees and mining ores while mounted.

characters.name: Mammorest Cryst
characters.description: The vegetation on its back varies from individual to individual. There was a time when seeds of presumed extinct plants were found still frozen on the back of a Mammorest Cryst.

partnerSkill.name: Ice Crusher
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Improves efficiency of cutting trees and mining ores while mounted.

characters.name: Maraith
characters.description: It relishes the peculiar scent living things give off when they are near death. If a Maraith has taken a liking to you, it is safe to assume that is why.

partnerSkill.name: Messenger of Death
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden. 

While in party,
all Party Pals' Active Skill cooldowns are reduced by 30% whenever you defeat an enemy. (does not stack)

characters.name: Mau
characters.description: Its hard tail does not deteriorate even when cut off. Some believed these severed tails to be good luck but, for the innumerable Mau who where poached as a result, they where anything but.

partnerSkill.name: Gold Digger
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Mau Cryst
characters.description: Its crystalline tail is beautiful, but shatters when this Pal dies. Some believe it is good luck to raise one, so Mau Cryst in captivity are treated with great care.

partnerSkill.name: Gold Digger
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up Gold Coin when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Melpaca
characters.description: Don't be fooled by its fluffy appearance. A hypersonic kick from one of its long legs may send you flying to the other side of the world.

partnerSkill.name: Pacapaca Wool
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden. 
While in party, increases Kingpaca's Defense and Movement speed.

Sometimes drops Wool when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Menasting
characters.description: Being made of pure energy, its insides are completely hollow. This Pal crams still-living prey into its hollow body, where it absorbs them. Hellish screams of pain can often be heard coming from inside this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Scorpion
partnerSkill.description: While in party, player's Defense increases by 5%, and Electric Pals drop 40% more items when defeated. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Menasting Terra
characters.description: The main body is an entity made of energy, with nothing inside. It stuffs earth and minerals into its outer shell, achieving overwhelming mass. Those who are stuck by it can only let out hellish groans.

partnerSkill.name: Steel Scorpion
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and Electric Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Mimog
characters.description: There was once a tradition of handing out an award to the person who met their end in the most foolish way. The first award was given for "being unaware of Mimog, opening the chest, and being bitten to death."

partnerSkill.name: Master of Unlocking
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Mimog can open treasure chests without using a key.

characters.name: Moldron
characters.description: In a healthy individual, the lava on its back flows smoothly. However, a poor lifestyle will gradually worsen its circulation, eventually causing a lava clog that results in a sudden, massive explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Magma Overload
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a mount.
This Pal's Attack increases for each other Fire or Ground Pal in your party.

characters.name: Mossanda
characters.description: A Pal so powerful it's hard to believe. In one experiment, this pal tore through 3,000 pieces of paper at once! It's only by some miracle this Pal isn't a meat-eater.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

characters.name: Mossanda Lux
characters.description: A Pal whose power is truly shocking. By altering the electrical currents in its body, this Pal has been able to overload its own strength. When it comes to sheer power, this Pal may be top of the list.

partnerSkill.name: Grenadier Panda
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a grenade launcher while mounted.

characters.name: Mozzarina
characters.description: Milk pours from this Pal like water from an open faucet, regardless of its gender. It's truly a mystery of life, although this mystery may be better left unsolved.

partnerSkill.name: Milk Maker
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes produces Milk when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Muffly
characters.description: Its soft facial fluff softens any hit, but it cannot groom itself well nor scratch its itches, leaving it in a constant state of mild frustration.

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy Flutterer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Freeze. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Munchill
characters.description: The inside of its mouth stays pleasantly cold, making it a natural fridge when closed. Its saliva contains enzymes that prevent food from rotting. Thus, it can serve as a food locker for humans—whether it is sanitary or not is another matter entirely.

partnerSkill.name: Icy Maw
partnerSkill.description: While in team, Munchill cools ingredients inside its mouth, making the food in your inventory less likely to spoil.

characters.name: Mycora
characters.description: It views humans as nothing more than convenient parasitic hosts. The reason Mycora has taken this form is to deceive humans into lowering their guard, allowing its spores to spread more efficiently.

partnerSkill.name: Charming Spore
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Medicine Production Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Necromus
characters.description: Once one with Paladius. Its darkened form is the embodiment of negative emotions. However, a glimmer of compassion can still be seen deep within its eyes.

alpha.name: Heat Resistant Pal Metal Armor Schematic 4

partnerSkill.name: Dark Knight of the Abyss
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted.

characters.name: Needoll
characters.description: Its spikes react to its emotions. A dearly cherished Needoll is something one may instinctively want to embrace. But more often than not, it ends in a tragic accident.

partnerSkill.name: Hug Me Please
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Needoll Noct
characters.description: Its spikes react to its emotions. A well-loved Needoll Noct clings to its owner, but accepting that love means accepting the pain too.

partnerSkill.name: Hug You So Much
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Status_Effects#:~:text=Ivy%2DCovered,-%5Bedit Ivy-Covered] 2. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Neptilius
characters.description: After the sealing of the calamity, a champion from Feybreak emerged. It stares out to sea, awaiting one it deems worthy. For such encounters are no coincidence—they are fate.

partnerSkill.name: Sentinel of the Great Sea
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together,  it follows up your attacks with spear strikes.  Can be ridden to travel quickly across water. While mounted, it can leap high into the air over water.

characters.name: Nitemary
characters.description: What it carries is its own soul. When it falls for someone, it forcibly extracts their soul and merges it with its own, yearning to become one.

partnerSkill.name: Soul Collector
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Pals drop more Pal Souls when defeated.

characters.name: Nitewing
characters.description: It carries newborn Pals to its nest and raises them as a surrogate parent. Once the baby Pal is of eating age, it hunts them.

partnerSkill.name: Travel Companion
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.

characters.name: Nox
characters.description: If you find Nox hair in your bedding, you should leave it where it lays and leave immediately. Picking it up is a one-way ticket to a never ending night.

partnerSkill.name: Kuudere
partnerSkill.description: When activated, detects the location of nearby [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Key_Item#Effigies:~:text=Pal%20Effigies Pal Effigies].

characters.name: Nyafia
characters.description: Strongly dislikes anyone catching a glimpse of its concealed eye. If you insist on trying, it'll burst into tears and ignore you for two weeks.

partnerSkill.name: Shot-Nyan Mode
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Nyafia will fire a shotgun at nearby enemies for a limited time.

characters.name: Omascul
characters.description: The mask it wears is not its face, they say. It seems in front, but it's not there, no way. From shadows deep, it watches night and day. Glance away, and closer it will stray.

partnerSkill.name: Masquerade Dance
partnerSkill.description: While in team, the Pals in the team gain more experience points.

characters.name: Ophydia
characters.description: Waters where Ophydias dwell are often filled with flowers that mimic its form. Many attempts have been made to directly propagate these blooms, but they inevitably wither the moment human hands interfere.

partnerSkill.name: Glorious Mist
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, the player's attacks inflict Soak. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Orserk
characters.description: It sends electricity into its foes' wounds, roasting them from the inside out. Fights between Orserk end in the blink of an eye.

partnerSkill.name: Ferocious Thunder Dragon
partnerSkill.description: While in party, hitting an enemy with a bullet increases the Attack and Defense of the Pal fighting alongside you by 1% for 5 seconds. This effect stacks up to 30 times. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Paladius
characters.description: Once one with Necromus. Its gleaming form is free of all negative emotions. However, a glimmer of hatred can still be seen deep within its eyes.

alpha.name: Cold Resistant Pal Metal Armor Schematic 4

partnerSkill.name: Holy Knight of the Firmament
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can triple jump while mounted.

characters.name: Palumba
characters.description: Disrupts enemies’ rhythm with a signature dance. In turf battles, the first to fall in sync with the other’s rhythm loses. Courtship, boredom, battle—it all comes down to dance! Now then, what could a dance aimed at a human possibly mean?

partnerSkill.name: Samba Step
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Runs faster over grass.

characters.name: Panthalus
characters.description: The last of its species, keeping its sacred duty close to heart. Even should its long obligation ever be fulfilled, its cries for its mother would only be answered by a solitary echo.

partnerSkill.name: Resonant Guardian
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Only 1 can be summoned to a base. While at a base, it constantly patrols the skies and bombards intruders from high above.

characters.name: Pengullet
characters.description: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, but sadly, its desire to fly has remained as strong as ever. Even now, it tries to fly again in any way it can.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher and fires Pengullet as ammunition. Pengullet explodes on contact and is incapacitated.

characters.name: Pengullet Lux
characters.description: The feathers of this Pal have all but disappeared, and it can no longer fly. Yet its longing for the sky has turned to jealousy- so it harnessed electricity to strike down those who still soar.

partnerSkill.name: Pengullet Lux Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, the player equips a Rocket Launcher  and fires Pengullet Lux as ammunition.  Pengullet Lux explodes on contact and is incapacitated.

characters.name: Penking
characters.description: Surprisingly, it is unrelated to Pengullet. Ever wanting attention, this Pal will strut its stuff for any onlookers.

partnerSkill.name: Brave Sailor
partnerSkill.description: While in party, Fire Pals drop 40% more items when defeated.

characters.name: Penking Lux
characters.description: Its body changed color after gaining electricity to improve underwater hunting. As a result, it lost the affection of Pengullet- but strangely enough, it now has a loyal follower; Pengullet Lux.

partnerSkill.name: Unyielding Storm Commander
partnerSkill.description:
While in party,
improves player's and Pals' {{Icon|Water}} damage to enemy weak points by 25%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Petallia
characters.description: A Pal that transforms into a massive plant when at the end of its life. Once every ten years, a beautiful flower blooms and a new Petallia is born.

partnerSkill.name: Blessing of the Flower Spirit
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, soothing blossoms restore the player's Health by 75%.


While at a base, increases the Planting Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Pierdon
characters.description: It smashes its body against harder rocks to maintain its preferred shape. Those with noticeable dents are best left alone, much like people with a botched haircut.

partnerSkill.name: Power Stone
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Muddy. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Polapup
characters.description: Among Polapups, the fastest slider on the snow earns the highest respect. Sometimes, a too-forceful leap sends one tumbling from the sky— a common sight during territorial season. Forecast: clear skies with a chance of flying Polapups.

partnerSkill.name: Rider of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  Runs faster over snow. Can slide quickly down slopes.

characters.name: Prixter
characters.description: It has about 5,000 types of poison. Some of them are deadly enough to cause instant death, but all of them are too weak to have any effect.

partnerSkill.name: Scorpion Sonar
partnerSkill.description: When activated, it can analyze airborne particles and find a dungeon's exit.

characters.name: Prunelia
characters.description: Intelligent and graceful in its demeanor, it was frequently employed as an attendant by the island's nobles. However, when encountered at night, its face looked so eerie that it quickly fell out of favor.

partnerSkill.name: Prayer for Abundant Harvest
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, Prunelia's prayers bless the crops, increasing their harvest.

characters.name: Puffolt
characters.description: Its fluffy fur absorbs tremendous amounts of water when soaked. Shaking it dry releases a powerful electrical discharge, making bath time together a serious gamble.

partnerSkill.name: Crackle Booster
partnerSkill.description: While at a base, increases the Generating Electricity Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Pupperai
characters.description: Pupperai territorial disputes begin with a staredown and end in a single, quick strike. Training them to "stay" is risky business, as the "go" command triggers that same attack instinct.

partnerSkill.name: Best Boy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Weapons#:~:text=Melee%20Weapons melee weapon] damage by 10%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Pyrin
characters.description: Its entire body has evolved into a highly efficient radiator, gifting it with astounding stamina. When someone has mounted it, this Pal takes caution not to burn them.

partnerSkill.name: Red Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Fire while mounted.

characters.name: Pyrin Noct
characters.description: It burns mysterious dark matter as energy and expels the remaining particles from its body. If someone rides it, they should take care so as not to gallop down the path of darkness.

partnerSkill.name: Black Hare
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While mounted, changes the player's attack to {{icon|Dark}} and increases Attack by 5%

characters.name: Quivern
characters.description: Sleeping while cuddling a Quivern is said to be a heavenly experience, but there are some who have been crushed and sent to heaven by ones that toss and turn in their sleep.

partnerSkill.name: Sky Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. Enhances Dragon attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Quivern Botan
characters.description: When you hug Quivern Botan, if it smells like sunshine and meadows, tomorrow will be sunny. If it smells damp, tomorrow will be wet and miserable.

partnerSkill.name: Grass Dragon Affection
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. Enhances Grass attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Ragnahawk
characters.description: Some think it is a related species to Beakon, but there is in fact no connection. It mainly eats rocks, and after many long years its beak and head have hardened to accommodate this diet.

partnerSkill.name: Flame Wing
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount.  While mounted, changes the player's attack type to {{icon|Fire}} and increases Attack by 5%.

characters.name: Rayhound
characters.description: At full speed, it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning. If two Rayhounds collide, the sound is like that of a powerful thunderclap.

partnerSkill.name: Jumping Force
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.Can perform a double jump while mounted. This Pal's Movement Speed increases by 5% for each Electric Pal in your party. (Excluding Rayhound)

characters.name: Rayhound Cryst
characters.description: Sprinting across the tundra at full speed kicks up a blinding blizzard, leading to constant Rayhound Cryst collisions due to zero visibility.

partnerSkill.name: Snow Shepherd
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can perform a double jump while mounted. While in party, increases Defense of Ice Pals by 15%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Reindrix
characters.description: Its transparent cerulean antlers glow with the cold of absolute zero. Any who touch them with their bare hands are instantly frozen over and smashed to pieces.

partnerSkill.name: Cool Body
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Keeps the rider cool in hot environments.

characters.name: Relaxaurus
characters.description: Contrary to its blasé appearance, it's quite ferocious. It perceives everything in its sight as prey and will stop at nothing to devour it.

partnerSkill.name: Hungry Missile
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

characters.name: Relaxaurus Lux
characters.description: One day, Relaxaurus had an idea. Maybe it was about time for a change. Just then, an electric shock raced through its body!

partnerSkill.name: Missile Party
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can rapidly fire a missile launcher while mounted.

characters.name: Reptyro
characters.description: Magma-like blood runs throughout its body. If a large amount of water is thrown on it, this water rapidly heats, causing an immense vapor explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Ore-Loving Beast
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
While in party,
reduces the weight of all types of ore by 30%.
(Does not stack)

characters.name: Reptyro Cryst
characters.description: Ice cold blood runs throughout its body. If heated rapidly, its blood evaporates, causing an immense vapor explosion.

partnerSkill.name: Ice-Loving Beast
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in party, reduces weight of ore by 35%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Ribbuny
characters.description: A Pal who's never without a bright smile. Occasionally, it gets its tentacles tied up in knots by Cattiva's pranks. During those moments, its expression changes to something altogether demonic.

partnerSkill.name: Skilled Fingers
partnerSkill.description:
While in party, increases Attack of {{Icon|Neutral}} Pals by 15%. (Does not stack).

While at a base, increases the Handiwork work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Ribbuny Botan
characters.description: Always wears a cheerful smile. Sometimes, thanks to Cattiva's pranks, they end up tangled in tentacles and have to fight their way out! Even in tough situations, they keep smiling cheerfully.

partnerSkill.name: Grass Weaver
partnerSkill.description: While in team, increases Attack of Grass Pals. While at a base, increases work efficiency when working at  Weapon Workbench, Weapon Assembly Line, and other related facilities.

characters.name: Robinquill
characters.description: A Pal that is very similar to humans who hunt and live in the forests. It may prove to be a key for understanding what Pals are and how they diverged from humans so long ago.

partnerSkill.name: Grounded Archer
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the player's bow damage.

characters.name: Robinquill Terra
characters.description: A Pal that lives a hunting life in rocky areas and is very close to humans. When Robinquill Terra bones are found in ruins, there are always human bones found nearby as well.

partnerSkill.name: Hawk Eye
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, allows you to deal more damage to weak points.

characters.name: Rooby
characters.description: Wild Rooby surprisingly never get sick. Eating one piece of charcoal a day, made by burning a branch, is the secret to its eternal health.

partnerSkill.name: Tiny Spark
partnerSkill.description: While in team, increases Attack of Fire Pals.

characters.name: Roujay
characters.description: A thief by nature, it snatches items when no one is looking. No reason to be concerned when caught in the act. Once it swiftly steals your eyes, you won’t be seeing anything anyway.

partnerSkill.name: Dark-Nester
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While in party, increases player's and Pals' damage to enemies afflicted with Blind. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Rushoar
characters.description: Being an extremely aggressive Pal, it often picks fights before gauging its opponent's strength. Though small, its powerful charge can even send boulders flying.

partnerSkill.name: Hard Head
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  Increases efficiency of destroying Stone by 500%.

characters.name: Sekhmet
characters.description: Once a fierce creature feared as a symbol of death. When Anubis claimed that mantle, wealthy elites looking for a replacement beguiled the species with wine. Before long, Sekhmet became a symbol of high nobility.

partnerSkill.name: Desert Empress
partnerSkill.description:
While at base, boosts Anubis's work speed.
Increases efficiency if Sekhmet is also working at a Workbench, Workshop, or other related facilities. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Selyne
characters.description: The object floating behind, resembling the moon, is said to gradually become more circular with each passing generation. No one knows what will happen when the moon is full.

partnerSkill.name: Celestial Darkness
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Neutral and Dark attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Shadowbeak
characters.description: Born from the depths of insanity, its very existence should not be. Having lost all genetic ties to other Pals, one wonders if it could still even be considered a Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Modified DNA
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. While flying, movement speed is increased. Enhances Dark attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Shroomer
characters.description: Inhaling large amounts of its spores will put you into a trance. Sometimes, if Shroomer appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because it's high off its own spores.

partnerSkill.name: Rampant Spores
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Sometimes drops Mushroom or Cavern Mushroom when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Shroomer Noct
characters.description: The abundance of spores released by this Pal blocks out sunlight. Sometimes, if Shroomer Noct appears motionless, it's not because it's mimicking a mushroom, but rather because its own spores don't let it see anything.

partnerSkill.name: Roiling Spores
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While at a base, its mysterious spores slow the rate at which the SAN value of allies at the base decreases by 10%.

partnerSkill.name: Silk Maker
partnerSkill.description: When activated, attacks targeted enemy with a powerful Blizzard Spike. Sometimes produces High Quality Cloth when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Silvegis
characters.description: The metallic components around its neck possess magnetic properties. If the leg pieces get too close, they cling to it. When metal debris builds up on its neck, it grudgingly begins cleaning, and grows frustrated when they won't come off easily.

partnerSkill.name: Aegis Shield
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Increases the duration of the shield when using Aegis Charge while mounted.

characters.name: Skutlass
characters.description: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

partnerSkill.name: Fish Fillet
partnerSkill.description:
When activated, Skutlass becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2,600)

If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass will become incapacitated.

It will also become incapacitated if Iaigiri is used.

characters.name: Skutlass Ignis
characters.description: A bizarre species which temporarily separates its body and uses its bones to slice through enemies, at the risk of perishing itself upon taking too long. While unconfirmed, older individuals are said to deliberately stay separated in order to trigger their survival instincts and prolong their lifespans.

partnerSkill.name: Seared Fish Fillet
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Skutlass Ignis becomes the player's katana (Attack: 2,900). If it does not revert to its normal form quickly, Skutlass Ignis will become incapacitated. It will also become incapacitated if Iagiri is used.

characters.name: Slowatt
characters.description: Doing as they please, sleeping when they wish, and eating whatever they like. Surely, Slowatt must be toiling in secret to maintain such a luxury. ...Or so the old islanders told themselves, just to get by.

partnerSkill.name: Chillswitch
partnerSkill.description: While in party, when the player attacks an enemy afflicted with Electrify, the enemy discharges electricity, dealing damage equal to a percent of the player's attack damage to nearby enemies. (Does not stack.)

characters.name: Smokie
characters.description: The black flames are only warm to the touch, but anything that remains in contact with them slowly melts from the inside. Hold some cheese above them, and it becomes a true delicacy.

partnerSkill.name: Dig, Dog! Dig!
partnerSkill.description: When activated, uses its sharp sense of smell to detect nearby Chromite. While fighting together, a large amount of Chromite is obtained.

characters.name: Snock
characters.description: Tossing an Snock into the bath for a shock spa is considered a traditional health practice. That is to say, the results may be rather shocking.

partnerSkill.name: Charging Shell
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict Electrify. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Snugloo
characters.description: “To look at a Snugloo's eyes” is an expression which means to seek the unseen essence of things. Ironically, no researcher has ever confirmed whether Snugloos have eyes in the first place.

partnerSkill.name: Invisible Eye
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the chance of being detected by enemies. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Solenne
characters.description: Joy and misery come in equal measure for Solenne. Those who choose to take care of one must be prepared for what that entails.

partnerSkill.name: Untainted Maiden
partnerSkill.description: While in the party, increases the player's Attack in party of different Pal species.

characters.name: Solmora
characters.description: Its corkscrew tail acts as a propeller. Research claims that if its body could withstand the strain, it could reach speeds beyond 88 mph.

partnerSkill.name: Charming Fish
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water.
While in party, makes it easier to fish up talented Pals. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Sootseer
characters.description: It was once believed that as the world approached its end, the flame would weaken. Doomsayers would repeatedly rejoice when the flame began to weaken, but in the end, it turned out to be a prank by Sootseer. At least, for now.

partnerSkill.name: Grave Robber
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up Bone when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Souffline
characters.description: Its fluff can be used to hide away unpleasant memories. Once carried off by the wind, you can bid farewell to the darkness they carried.

partnerSkill.name: Fuzzy Fairy
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with Ivy-Covered. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Sparkit
characters.description: It is always on edge during the dry season. Sparks can fly with even the slightest provocation, even amongst allies.

partnerSkill.name: Static Electricity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases Attack of Electric Pals. (Does not stack.) Sometimes drops Electric Organ when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Splatterina
characters.description: It has an uncontrollable urge to tear its prey apart. Each individual has their own meticulous order for dismemberment. If caught by Splatterina, pray that your head is taken first.

partnerSkill.name: Blade of Uncontrolled Passion
partnerSkill.description: While in possession, the amount of items obtained from using the Meat Cleaver increases.

characters.name: Starryon
characters.description: It takes great pride in its flowing, gorgeous mane. If it finds a split end, it becomes so mortified it can't focus on running properly. Because static electricity makes its hair frizzy, it avoids Azurmane at all costs.

partnerSkill.name: Night Dancer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Increases movement speed while mounted at night.

characters.name: Surfent
characters.description: Its hydrodynamic form is well suited to life in water. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Swimmer
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden to travel on water. 

Sometimes drops Leather when assigned to Ranch.

characters.name: Surfent Terra
characters.description: Its aerodynamic form is well suited to life on the sand. Poachers often catch them and use them in place of surfboards.

partnerSkill.name: Sand Swimmer
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Surfent Terra helps carry supplies, decreasing the weight of ores in the player's inventory.

characters.name: Suzaku
characters.description: It was once believed to usher in the dry season. Whenever there was a drought the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to bring about a plentiful harvest in the next year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Flame
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Fire attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Suzaku Aqua
characters.description: It was once believed to usher in the rainy season. If there was a flood the previous year, people would relentlessly seek to cull its numbers, hoping to avert disaster in the coming year.

partnerSkill.name: Wings of Water
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Enhances Water attacks while mounted.

characters.name: Swee
characters.description: Crawling along the ground, it eats microscopic organic matter. After a while, it discharges any substances that provide no nutrition. By using it as a mop for cleaning, everyone wins!

partnerSkill.name: Fluffy
partnerSkill.description: While in team, Sweepa's stats will be increased.

characters.name: Sweepa
characters.description: While hibernating, a large number of Swee hide within its voluminous body hair. The most ever recorded is 101.

partnerSkill.name: King of Fluff
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, stats will increase the more Swee are in your team.

characters.name: Tanzee
characters.description: Long ago, this Pal used long objects like tree branches as weapons. After coming into contact with humans, however, it found something much more effective: guns.

partnerSkill.name: Cheery Rifle
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Tanzee will mercilessly fire an assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

characters.name: Tanzee Ignis
characters.description: Its palms have evolved to handle burning objects without getting scorched. When its gun runs out of ammo, it may grab the heated barrel with its bare hands and use it to club its foes.

partnerSkill.name: Chipper Chimp Gunfire
partnerSkill.description: When activated, Tanzee Ignis will mercilessly fire a Fire assault rifle at nearby enemies for a limited time.

characters.name: Tarantriss
characters.description: Extremely sticky and clingy. The more it's resisted, the more tenacious it becomes. Such is its "personality."

partnerSkill.name: Tarantriss’ Web
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Can double jump while mounted. Additionally, can shoot spider silk to grapple and move at fast speed.

characters.name: Teafant
characters.description: Large amounts of water pour from what is thought to be its nose, though some say that it is, in fact, just snot. This has sparked a fierce debate among Pal scholars.

partnerSkill.name: Soothing Shower
partnerSkill.description: While in party, restores 20% of the player's Health when Health falls below 30%. (Does not stack) (120-second cooldown after activation)

characters.name: Tetroise
characters.description: Those stones on its back are not just cargo. Set them down somewhere distant and they will slowly make their way back home.

partnerSkill.name: Masonry Archelon
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden.
While at a base, increases the Mining Work Suitability Level for all other Base Pals by +1.
(Does not stack)

characters.name: Tocotoco
characters.description: A frightening Pal that produces exploding eggs. It often fires these eggs from its rear end as a form of defense, but when spent, the Pal itself explodes.

partnerSkill.name: Eggbomb Launcher
partnerSkill.description: When activated, equips to the player and transforms into an egg launcher.

characters.name: Tombat
characters.description: Often appears out of the blue to flaunt its prized wings in front of other Pals. Although this appears to be an intimidation tactic, the Pal seems to derive some kind of pleasure from the display.

partnerSkill.name: Ultrasonic Sensor
partnerSkill.description: When activated, uses ultrasonic waves to detect the location of nearby Pals.

characters.name: Tropicaw
characters.description: While some say that it flails around to mimic flowers swaying in the wind and avoid predators, others argue that a crimson flower thrashing violently at high speeds is simply so unsettling that nothing dares approach it.

partnerSkill.name: Flower Dance
partnerSkill.description: While in party, extends the invincibility period during dodge rolls and dodge steps. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Turtacle
characters.description: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. Unfortunately, it's utterly defenseless underneath. Even a little tickle could knock it out cold.

partnerSkill.name: Spikey Carrier
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces Ore weight by 80%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Turtacle Terra
characters.description: To protect its fragile body, it developed an incredibly tough shell. With most of its senses concentrated in its limbs and shell, it can’t even tell if someone quietly touches its core.

partnerSkill.name: Shiny Hauler
partnerSkill.description: While in team,  Turtacle Terra helps carry supplies,  decreasing the weight of armor in the player's inventory.  Also increases Attack of Ground Pals.

characters.name: Univolt
characters.description: It used to be considered an emissary of the Thunder God, and thus was not hunted by people. However, after witnesses observed one die from a lightning strike, its reverence faded, and it quite literally fell into the role of a workhorse.

partnerSkill.name: Swift Deity
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. Changes the player's attack type to Electric while mounted.

characters.name: Vaelet
characters.description: The castle was filled with the king's favorite flowers. A great battle ensued, and flames approached the castle. Amidst the chaos, the spirit of a flower appeared. - From the fairy tale, "The King's Flower."

partnerSkill.name: Purification of Gaia
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, Ground Pals drop more items when defeated.

characters.name: Valentail
characters.description: In older paintings, it is depicted as much smaller than it is today. For reasons unknown, various parts of its body have begun to elongate rapidly in recent years, and it is predicted to reach nearly ten times its current size within the next century.

partnerSkill.name: Big Stretch
partnerSkill.description: While in party, reduces the effects of gravity on the player, making them more floaty while jumping and falling.(Does not stack)

characters.name: Vanwyrm
characters.description: The melodies of a flute made from the exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm are said to cross whole mountain ranges. In ages past, such flutes were used to signal an attack.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Increases damage player deals to enemy weak points while mounted.

characters.name: Vanwyrm Cryst
characters.description: The melodies of a flute made from an exoskeleton of a Vanwyrm Cryst are said to cross whole mountains ranges. In ages past, such flutes where used to signal victory in battle.

partnerSkill.name: Aerial Marauder
partnerSkill.description:
Can be ridden as a flying mount. 

While in party, increases damage player deals to enemy weak points by 30%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Venusa
characters.description: Whenever it's confused, it resorts to consulting with the snakes on its head. However, since they're all ultimately the same being, it comes to understand that nothing is understood.

partnerSkill.name: Snake's Sagacity
partnerSkill.description: While in party, the player's attacks inflict [https://palworld.wiki.gg/wiki/Status_Effects#Blind:~:text=Blind,-%5Bedit Blind]. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Verdash
characters.description: Land that Verdash has run across becomes extremely fertile, with thick vegetation growing there soon after. It will not run anywhere that herbicide has been used.

partnerSkill.name: Grassland Speedster
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, increases player's movement speed and  changes the player's attack type to Grass.

characters.name: Vixy
characters.description: The idol of Palpagos Islands. If you bully a Vixy, you best be prepared to become enemies with the whole world.

partnerSkill.name: Dig Here!
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes digs up items from the ground when assigned to the ranch.

characters.name: Warsect
characters.description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. Even a napalm blast would hardly leave a scratch.

partnerSkill.name: Hard Armor
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and reduces damage received from Fire.

characters.name: Warsect Terra
characters.description: The ultra-hard armor surrounding its body is extremely strong and heat resistant. It doesn't flinch even if a Mammorest steps on it.

partnerSkill.name: Fortified Shell
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, increases the player's defense and reduces damage received from Fire.

characters.name: Whalaska
characters.description: When it sleeps, Pals often mistake it for a drifting piece of ice and rest on it. Although gentle and unwilling to push them away when awake, it feels quietly stressed by the intrusion on its personal space.

partnerSkill.name: Chilled Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While fighting together, the fishing minigame  starts with the capture gauge higher than usual. Additionally, the capture gauge fills faster  when the bar is aligned.

characters.name: Whalaska Ignis
characters.description: Determined never to be mistaken for drift ice again, it turned bright red through sheer will. Unfortunately, some Pals can’t see red. So despite its efforts, its personal space continues to be invaded.

partnerSkill.name: Cozy Whale Cruiser
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden.  While fighting together, the fishing minigame  starts with the capture gauge higher than usual.  Additionally, the capture gauge fills faster  when the bar is aligned.

characters.name: Wispaw
characters.description: The ghostly hands behind it embody the souls of all humans who have raised its kind. Lately, they seem to have reached a unanimous consensus to dote on Wispaw.

partnerSkill.name: Death-Cheating Feline
partnerSkill.description: While in party, increases the capture rate when awarded a back bonus. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Wixen
characters.description: With the power of light, it produces arcane phenomena. it prefers to eat food well-done and is particularly hostile towards Katress.

partnerSkill.name: Lord Fox
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Fire.

characters.name: Wixen Noct
characters.description: Due to its upbringing, it no longer cares about whether its food is cooked enough. This Pal stopped worrying about those details, and just prefers its food to be as sweet as possible. Not on good terms with Katress Ignis.

partnerSkill.name: Black Fox Lord
partnerSkill.description: While fighting together, changes the player's attack type to Dark.

characters.name: Woolipop
characters.description: Its entire body is 18,000 times sweeter then sugar. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent will find themselves overwhelmed by sweetness and even pass out should they take a bite of this Pal.

partnerSkill.name: Candy Pop
partnerSkill.description:
Sometimes drops Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch.

White at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals by -10%. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Woolipop Terra
characters.description: Its fur emits a sweet smell, but its meat is disgustingly bitter. Carnivorous Pals lured by its scent into taking a bite will find themselves overwhelmed by the foul taste and pass out.

partnerSkill.name: Bitter Pop
partnerSkill.description: Sometimes drops Caramel Cotton Candy when assigned to Ranch. While at a base, reduces Hunger depletion rate of Base Pals. (Does not stack)

characters.name: Wumpo
characters.description: Researchers once tried to shave off its hair to reveal its true form. In the end, only hair was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the Snowy Mountain
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Wumpo helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

characters.name: Wumpo Botan
characters.description: Researchers once tried to cut the grass off its body to reveal its true form. In the end, only grass was left, as if that was all there was to begin with.

partnerSkill.name: Guardian of the South
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in team, Wumpo Botan helps carry supplies, increasing the player's max carrying capacity.

characters.name: Xenogard
characters.description: Consumes information and turns it into energy. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone.- Hello? What was the message you just sent? I devoured it before checking.

partnerSkill.name: Crater Enthusiast
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While in the team, it's easier to obtain Meteorite Fragment and Pure Quartz.

characters.name: Xenolord
characters.description: -Destination reached. Priority: Locate entity

partnerSkill.name: Meteor Wings
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden as a flying mount. Greatly increases movement speed while flying.

characters.name: Xenovader
characters.description: Can send information and convert it into energy by forgetting it. Regularly seems to be sending information to someone.- Respond. Target located. Proceed to immediate destruction.

partnerSkill.name: Meteor Mania
partnerSkill.description: While in the team, increases damage dealt to ores, and it's easier to obtain Meteorite Fragment.

characters.name: Yakumo
characters.description: It has a strong sense of justice and despises evil. In the past they were faithful and loving companions to the islanders. Nowadays, Yakumos are hostile to humans wherever they spot them.

partnerSkill.name: Birds of a Feather
partnerSkill.description: Can be ridden. While fighting together, it becomes easier to encounter pals with the same Passive Skill as this Pal. (Excludes certain Passive Skills)
